hook: A new detector called IdeaLens reveals if an AI generated your scientific paper's core concepts.

sections.voiceover: A new detector called IdeaLens reveals if an AI generated your scientific paper's core concepts.
b_roll: Close-up of a scientific paper document on a digital tablet

sections.voiceover: Rishanth Rajendhran and Minjoon Choi built this tool to analyze the structure of research documents. How does IdeaLens know?
b_roll: Portrait of researchers working on a computer
Abstract diagram of an outline structure
Close-up of the IdeaLens logo or interface

sections.voiceover: IdeaLens represents documents as outlines, pairing a discourse role with a brief description of ideas.
b_roll: Animation showing a document transforming into an outline

sections.voiceover: Elizabeth Gibney reports in Nature that this method identifies AI-generated concepts rather than writing style. Jeffrey Brainard notes in Science that editors now distinguish AI-polished text from fully AI-generated papers.
b_roll: Graphic of a journal editor reviewing a paper

sections.voiceover: Science and Nature report that editors are drawing a line against fully AI-generated research papers.
b_roll: Close-up of the IdeaLens tool interface
